title_zh: v214：二维观测与已知几何足以复现 Case 5 的谱对齐判别
title_en: v214: 2D observations and known geometry reproduce the Case 5 spectral-alignment decision

proxy_input_barrier.truth_role: Opened 3D fields generate noiseless synthetic observations and support post-proxy diagnostics only; they never enter the proxy function.

fixed_primary.name: worst-frame harmonic observability of the unregularized low-64 Moore-Penrose observation proxy

source_blind_control.name: v210 trace-normalized low-64 Gram spectral floor

interpretation_zh: v214 用已知几何和当前二维观测复现了 v213 的严格谱对齐分离：169/169 个跨族比较全部通过，严格间隔为 0.39730，而源盲 control 仍是 167/169。这排除了部署时必须读三维真值才能获得该判别信号的解释，但它仍是无噪声合成观测上的 post-open 机制诊断，还没有通过 warm-start 物理重放、matched-accuracy 或资源门。
interpretation_en: v214 reproduces the v213 strict spectral-alignment separation using known geometry and the current 2D observation: all 169/169 cross-family comparisons pass with a strict gap of 0.39730, while the source-blind control remains at 167/169. This rejects the explanation that deployment-time 3D truth is required to obtain the decision signal. It remains a post-open mechanism diagnostic with noiseless synthetic observations and has not passed warm-start physical replay, matched-accuracy, or resource gates.
route_action_zh: 下一步结果前单独冻结最小 warm-start 可行性实验：把 observation-only 代理场送入未修改 CGLS，用实际 A/A^T 回执与 Zero/BP/CGLS/PCGLS 及便宜 control 公平比较。
route_action_en: Freeze a separate minimal warm-start feasibility experiment before results: feed the observation-only proxy field into unchanged CGLS and compare it fairly against Zero/BP/CGLS/PCGLS and cheap controls using actual A/AT receipts.
